name: Legerdemain — B must share one of A's types (artifact or creature): with a creature as A, an artifact is not offered and is not exchanged
notes: "Exchange control of target artifact or creature and another target permanent that shares one of those types with it." Found by the exchange-control audit unit (2026-11-18). _exchangeControlSlotRules read "target X and target Y" but not "… and another target Y", so the pair rule (shareTypesWithA) was never set: with Grizzly Bears as A, Sol Ring was offered as B and the two were exchanged. Now B with Grizzly Bears as A is the opponent's Hill Giant alone, and the Bears and Sol Ring pair exchanges nothing (CR 701.12b).
